decisions.reason: The firm has already invested in developing the sensor module and committed to it publicly, and with only one year on the market the weak visibility can still be put down to a normal ramp-up, so management will persist.
The product has its own page, which signals the firm's strongest public commitment and its centrality to the industrial I/O line, and that makes dropping it very unlikely.

The relay module fits the firm's established industrial module portfolio and was cheap to add, so the sunk development effort and its link to the product line favour keeping it while early results mature.

The server room kit lies somewhat further from the core industrial focus and is only mentioned on the website, but after one year management will still attribute any weak results to temporary market entry effects and keep it.
